cases.title: Password reset
cases.requirement: A registered user must request a password reset after identity verification. Reset tokens expire within 15 minutes, cannot be reused, and invalid or expired tokens are rejected. Enforce the password policy, rate limit requests, audit the event, and invalidate existing sessions after a successful reset.

cases.title: Checkout
cases.requirement: A customer must complete checkout with a validated shipping address and payment authorization. The system must prevent duplicate charges, reject invalid payment details, handle payment provider failure, and show a clear order confirmation.

cases.title: User registration
cases.requirement: A visitor must register with a unique verified email and a password that meets the password policy. Duplicate emails and invalid verification links are rejected, registration is rate limited, and the account remains inactive until verification succeeds.

cases.title: Refund
cases.requirement: A support agent must issue a refund only for an eligible paid order. The system must prevent duplicate refunds, reject invalid order references, record an audit entry, and show the payment-provider failure outcome.

cases.title: Role-based access
cases.requirement: An administrator must assign roles while the system enforces permission checks for every protected action. Unauthorized users are rejected, role changes are audited, and revoked permissions take effect immediately.

cases.title: File upload
cases.requirement: A signed-in user must upload an allowed file type within the configured size limit. The system rejects invalid types, oversized files, and malware findings, stores the upload securely, and records an audit event.

cases.title: Subscription cancellation
cases.requirement: A subscriber must cancel an active subscription after confirmation. The system must reject invalid subscription states, stop future renewal charges, preserve access until the paid period ends, and record the cancellation reason.

cases.title: Payment retry
cases.requirement: The system must retry a failed payment using idempotency protection and a bounded retry schedule. It must prevent duplicate charges, record each attempt, stop after the retry limit, and notify the customer of the final failure.
